findings.title: get_monitor_environment_context discards the mutated config copy
findings.body: `get_monitor_environment_context()` copies `monitor.config` into a local `config` and replaces `config["schedule_type"]` with its human-readable display value, but the returned dict sets `"config": monitor_environment.monitor.config` (the original object), so the local `config` variable is dead code. The occurrence's monitor context therefore carries the raw integer `schedule_type` instead of the display string, which is almost certainly not the intent and affects what is rendered on the issue. Return `config` instead.

findings.title: Public helpers removed from mark_failed without updating importers/tests
findings.body: This change deletes the module-level names `mark_failed_threshold`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence`, `get_failure_reason`, `get_monitor_environment_context`, `SimpleCheckIn`, `HUMAN_FAILURE_STATUS_MAP` and `SINGULAR_HUMAN_FAILURE_MAP` from `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed`, but no test or other call-site files are touched in this PR. Any code or test that imports these from `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed` (or that monkeypatches/mocks `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed.create_issue_platform_occurrence`) will now fail with ImportError or silently patch nothing. The importers and mock targets need to be updated to the new `logic.incidents` / `logic.incident_occurrence` modules as part of this move.

findings.title: get_failure_reason docstring example does not match behavior
findings.body: The docstring claims an example output of "A failed check-in was detected", but the singular map only contains error/missed/timeout phrasings, so that string can never be produced. The docstring also contains typos ("humam readible"). Minor, but misleading for future callers reasoning about the user-visible failure reason text.
